PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/bricks-ext#>
SELECT ?ts ?point ?label WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER (regex(?label, "Perimeter_bot_ZN_3", "i"))
  ?point brick:hasSubArea ?zone .
  ?point a brick:Occupancy .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/bricks-ext#>

  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
  ?point a ?p .
  FILTER (regex(str(?p), "Occupancy", "i"))
} LIMIT 50
